theme_strategy: Light Theme Default (Premium Cockpit feel). A pristine, high-contrast, energetic workspace designed to keep sales velocity high without visual fatigue.
persona_and_vibe: Bold, Premium, Visual, Fast, Energetic, Clean, Professional. Inspired by Linear and Supabase but infused with high-energy sales mechanics.

typography.fallback_strategy: If Outfit/Manrope are unavailable, use Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous container padding with dense, functional internal card spacing. Optical alignment everywhere.
spacing_and_layout.kanban_layout: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-6 snap-x snap-mandatory

surfaces_and_shadows.floating_panel: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-white/60
surfaces_and_shadows.glass_header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200/50 sticky top-0 z-50

motion_and_interactions.kanban_drag: scale-105 shadow-2xl rotate-2 cursor-grabbing ring-2 ring-primary_brand
motion_and_interactions.sparkline_draw: Use Framer Motion to draw stroke length on mount.

component_instructions.snapshot_cards: Top dashboard cards must feature large 'Outfit' numbers, a Phosphor duotone icon, and a Recharts sparkline at the bottom matching the semantic color of the metric.
component_instructions.kanban_pipeline: Smooth drag-and-drop. Cards in 'Lost' get desaturated. Cards dropped in 'Converted/Won' trigger canvas-confetti blast.
component_instructions.live_activity_stream: Vertical feed with connecting 2px lines (border-l-2). Avatars overlapping. New items slide in from top.
component_instructions.lead_profile: Left col: Huge avatar, sticky 'Quick Actions' (Call/WhatsApp). Right col: Shadcn Tabs for Overview/Timeline.
component_instructions.floating_call_ui: Bottom right fixed panel. Glassmorphism. Waveform animation when speaking using staggered framer-motion bars.
component_instructions.whatsapp_ui: Familiar bubble chat interface. Use green accents. Input field with 'Send' action.
component_instructions.mobile_nav: Sticky bottom nav. Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80`. Central 'Quick Add' FAB (Floating Action Button) protruding upwards.

libraries_and_packages: recharts (for snapshot sparklines and funnel graphic)

accessibility.contrast: Text inside semantic status badges (e.g., Warning Amber) MUST be high contrast (e.g., Amber-900 text on Amber-100 bg).
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for the confetti and pipeline drag animations.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, inputs, links, and kanban cards MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="lead-card-john-doe"`).

backgrounds.description: Subtle glass hallway for auth page background

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align standard text. Ditch boring enterprise tables—use layered list-cards instead. Add generous padding (p-6 to p-8). Apply distinct hover states with slight Y-translation to all interactive cards. NEVER use transparent headers without blur backing. NEVER use placeholder.com images. Ensure pure .js/.jsx usage as this is a JS environment. Every button and interaction surface must have a `data-testid`.
